ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Through which part is carbon dioxide absorbed?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the picture is a plant, with green leaves, stem and roots, the roots are in the soil, there is the sun in the upper right, and there are arrows and letter labels around the plant. Reasoning: The question asks through which part of the plant carbon dioxide is absorbed. When a plant carries out photosynthesis, carbon dioxide mainly enters the plant from the air through the stomata on the leaves. Therefore the answer is leaf.
